reason: I have freelancers I already trust and I go to them first. I'm not going to put company money into an unaudited smart contract on a brand new platform and then have to explain that to my boss.
objection: Money locked in a smart contract from a very new, unaudited product. Paying in USDC on Solana is also not how my company pays freelancers, and if something goes wrong I'm the one accountable.
would_change_my_mind: An independent audit, plus a way to pay by card or invoice and a few references from marketing leads at real companies who have used it.
